application.title: Your application
application.intro: Brain Trails is in a closed beta. Tell us who you are and how you would use it: we read every application and choose a small group to start with.

profile.label: I am applying as
profile.lab_lead: The lead of a research lab
profile.lab_member: A researcher or student in a lab

application.registration_no_hint: Your registration with your professional body.
application.purpose: What would you like to do with Brain Trails?
application.detected: Filled in from this browser; correct it if you will record elsewhere.
application.bluetooth_ok: This browser can pair a headband.
application.bluetooth_missing: This browser cannot pair a headband over Bluetooth. You can still apply: tell us which device you would record on.
application.expected_subjects: How many people would you record?
application.contact_ok: You may contact me for feedback during the beta.

auth.waitlisted: Your application is on the waiting list. We will write to you as soon as there is room.

preflight.title: Before you start
preflight.intro: Put the headband on and wait until all four lights are green. The recording starts with the session and stops at its end.
preflight.unsupported: This browser cannot pair a headband. Use Chrome or Edge on a computer, or the Brain Trails app on iPhone and iPad.
preflight.contact_wait: Waiting for good contact on all four sensors.
preflight.contact_ok: Good contact on all four sensors.

surface.fullscreen_failed: Full screen was refused; the session runs in the window.

upload.title: Saving the session
upload.failed: The recording could not be uploaded: {message}
upload.nothing: The session stopped before anything was recorded.
upload.sync_failed: No signal arrived from the headband. Check that it is on and paired, then try again.
upload.dropped: The headband disconnected, so the session stopped. What was recorded until then has been kept.

consent.title: Before you begin
consent.agree: I have read this and I agree to take part.

help.title: Where the sensors sit
help.intro: The band holds four dry electrodes against the skin: two on the forehead just above the eyebrows, two behind the ears. The lights follow the band from left to right as you wear it, so the leftmost light is the sensor behind your left ear.

common.media_error: This could not be played. You can continue with the session.

baseline.open: Keep your eyes open and rest your gaze on the cross.
baseline.closed: Close your eyes and relax. A tone will tell you when to open them.
baseline.closed_silent: Close your eyes and relax until the screen changes.

rest.self_paced: Take your time. Press Finish when you are done.

text.error: This text could not be loaded. You can continue with the session.

arousal.question: How calm or excited did you feel?

dominance.question: How much in control did you feel?

mental.question: How mentally demanding was the task?

physical.question: How physically demanding was the task?

temporal.question: How hurried or rushed was the pace of the task?

performance.question: How successful were you in doing what you were asked to do?

effort.question: How hard did you have to work to reach your level of performance?

frustration.question: How insecure, discouraged, irritated, stressed or annoyed were you?

coding.key: Which digit goes with which symbol

heartbeat.ready: At the tone, start counting your heartbeats silently. Do not touch your pulse. Count only the beats you really feel.
heartbeat.counting: Count your heartbeats until the next tone.
heartbeat.how_many: How many heartbeats did you count?

builder.not_found: This protocol is not in your catalog.
builder.read_only: This protocol belongs to someone else. Make a copy to edit it.
builder.not_saved_yet: Not saved yet - it is kept as soon as you add something.

publish.summary_hint: What it does, in a sentence.
publish.invalid: This protocol cannot be published yet:

builder.conflict: This protocol was saved somewhere else. Reload it to keep editing; your unsaved changes here would overwrite theirs.

group.repetitions_hint: How many times the whole table is run.
group.order_hint: The order the group's content is played in.

group.conditions_hint: One column per value the blocks read, one row per condition.

builder.select_a_clip: Select a block on the timeline to change its settings.
builder.preview_empty: There is nothing to preview yet: drag something onto the timeline.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.empty: Drag media or an element here, or double-click it.

bin.title: Bin
bin.no_media: Nothing to use yet. Upload a video or a sound.

form.unsupported: This setting has no form yet. It is shown as it is saved and kept as it is.
form.nothing_to_set: Nothing to set: this block works as it is.

inspector.title: Block
inspector.label: Name
inspector.kind_hint: The type is chosen when the block is added and cannot be changed here.
inspector.condition_hint: A word for what this block is in your experiment (calm, scary, control). Blocks with the same condition are compared together in the review and in the exported data. Leave empty if you are not comparing anything.
inspector.skippable: The participant may skip this block
inspector.unknown_kind_hint: This app does not know this block type. Its settings are kept untouched.
inspector.around: Timing around the block, and analysis
inspector.pre_fixation_s_hint: Shows a fixation cross for this long before the block starts, to settle the eyes.
inspector.jitter_s_hint: Adds a random time, up to this much, to the cross before the block, so the participant cannot predict the exact start.
inspector.post_rest_s_hint: An empty screen for this long after the block, to let the signal come back to rest.
inspector.skippable_hint: Shows a Skip button. The skip is written in the timeline, so you know the block was not completed.

monitor.empty: Drag a video or an element onto the timeline below. What the participant will see shows up here.
monitor.split_hint: Pause the video where you want the cut, then split: you get two clips over the same video, and can put a questionnaire or a rest between them.

beta.promptTitle: Want to try what comes next?
beta.promptText: Brain Trails is in a closed beta. Beta testers get new protocols and features first, for free, and we ask them what they think. Applying takes a few questions.
beta.promptLaterHint: You can apply any time from your account.

missing.not_ready: Not computed for this recording yet

alpha.name: Alpha
alpha.meaning: Share of the signal's power at 8–12 Hz: relaxed, eyes-closed rhythm.

beta.name: Beta
beta.meaning: Share of power at 13–30 Hz: alert, engaged activity.

theta.name: Theta
theta.meaning: Share of power at 4–8 Hz: drowsiness, or effortful focus.

delta.name: Delta
delta.meaning: Share of power below 4 Hz: deep sleep, or movement and blinks.

entropy.name: Entropy
entropy.meaning: How hard it is to predict the next state from this one.

recurrence.name: Recurrence
recurrence.meaning: How often the signal went back to a state it had already visited.

modularity.name: Modularity
modularity.meaning: How much states group together by the kind of trial.

diameter.name: Diameter
diameter.meaning: How wide the space the signal covered was.

stretching.name: Stretching
stretching.meaning: Average step from one state to the next, compared with the diameter.

accuracy.name: Right actions
accuracy.meaning: Share of trials where the person did what the task asked.

reaction_time.name: Reaction time
reaction_time.meaning: Typical time from the target appearing to the press.

rt_spread.name: Reaction spread
rt_spread.meaning: How much reaction time varied: lower is steadier.

hit_rate.name: Targets caught
hit_rate.meaning: Share of targets that were answered.

false_alarms.name: False alarms
false_alarms.meaning: Share of non-targets that were pressed anyway.

landscape.title: Brain Landscape
landscape.intro: Every recording you have made, on one map. Peaks are where your brain spent the most time; hover anywhere to see what you were doing there.
landscape.meta: {n, plural, one {# recording} other {# recordings}} · {windows} seconds of signal · updated {date}
landscape.aria: Your brain landscape: every recording on one map, height is where you spent the most time
landscape.notReady: Your landscape appears once your first recording has been analysed.
landscape.disclaimer: Exploratory, not diagnostic. The map moves each time you record: places on it compare within one version, not across versions.
